item.title: The Master and His Emissary by Iain McGilchrist: Part 2
item.description: This article is about part 2 of the book The Master and His Emissary by Iain McGilchrist. In part 1, Iain gives us a comprehensive overview of the anatomy of our brain, what cognitive functions and abilities are associated with which hemisphere, and how the hemispheres each see and interact with the self, the world and subjective experience. Due to their frequent use, right hemisphere is abbreviated as RH and left hemisphere as LH.

item.title: The Master and His Emissary by Iain McGilchrist: Part 1
item.description: This article is about part one of the book The Master and His Emissary (2009) by Iain McGilchrist. In part one, Iain gives us a comprehensive overview of the anatomy of our brain, what cognitive functions and abilities are associated with which hemisphere, and how the hemispheres each see and interact with the self and the world, and how they provide the foundations for our subjective experience. Due to their frequent use, “right hemisphere” is abbreviated as RH and “left hemisphere” as LH.
